title: Your Birth Number Reveals Your Hidden Gift

segments.text: Add the digits of the day you were born. That one number carries a gift.
Born on the twenty-eighth? Two plus eight is ten. One plus zero is one.

segments.title: ONE
segments.text: One. You begin what others only dream about.

segments.title: TWO
segments.text: Two. You bring peace into every room.

segments.title: FOUR
segments.text: Four. People build their lives on your loyalty.

segments.title: FIVE
segments.text: Five. You were born to be free.

segments.title: SIX
segments.text: Six. You love like a home.

segments.title: SEVEN
segments.text: Seven. You see what others miss.

segments.title: EIGHT
segments.text: Eight. You turn effort into abundance.

segments.title: NINE
segments.text: Nine. An old soul, here to heal.
What's your number? Comment it, and send this to someone who shares it.
